title: TokanRaider
tagline: TokanRaider is a 2D role playing game where players navigate the world to discover and collect unique NFTs. Built with Unity and dojo, it features pixel-art graphics, starknet integration for easy and secure NFT minting and transfer.
description: This project is called TokanRaider which is 2d rpg game where player can kill slimes,ghost and aliens to obtain clues of the token hidden in the map. This game has total of five levels each level with its own difficultly and higher rewards. TokanRaider is a well-conceived project that leverages modern technologies to deliver a unique gaming experience. By combining Unity's powerful game development capabilities with the secure and scalable nature of Starknet, TokanRaider stands out as a pioneering example of integrating blockchain technology into mainstream gaming.
how_its_made: This projects built with unity for the frontend and dojo for the backend. Each kill and movement is recorded in starknet as a transaction. This era of provable games has given us an edge for this to be something bigger. The use of Starknet for token transactions ensures that the game can handle a large number of players without significant performance degradation. Additionally, Unity's flexible architecture allows for the easy addition of new content and features, ensuring that TokanRaider can grow and evolve over time.
